## Step 4: Create a blog post

### 📖 Theory: Jekyll blog posts and frontmatter

Jekyll uses specially named files and frontmatter to create blog posts. Files must be named `_posts/YYYY-MM-DD-title.md`.

### ⌨️ Activity: Create a blog post

1. Browse to the `main` branch.
1. Click `Add file` > `Create new file`.
1. Name the file `_posts/YYYY-MM-DD-title.md`.
1. Add frontmatter at the top:

   ```yaml
   ---
   title: "YOUR-TITLE"
   date: YYYY-MM-DD
   ---
   ```

1. Commit your changes to the `main` branch.
